'''Ironi Tiberias''' ({{langx|he|עירוני טבריה}}) is an Israeli professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Tiberias]]. The club is not connected to [[Hapoel Tiberias F.C.|Hapoel Tiberias]], a former club which spent several seasons in the top division of Israeli football in the 1960s and the 1980s, making its last appearance in the top flight in 1989."}}
